root_causes.pending_offscreen: The global overlay was fixed-position, but its card had no mobile viewport max-height/overflow contract. On shorter Android viewports the centered card could extend beyond the usable screen.
root_causes.image_flicker: The image timer fired once per second, but each change also triggered an opacity/scale transition and a second 180 ms delayed state change. Visually that produces two flashes per image cycle rather than one clean image change.
root_causes.partial_route: The live router accepted a partially-routed plan after transient per-leg OSRM failures. 1917 correctly preserved live geometry, but that also preserved missing first/final live legs instead of retrying them.
root_causes.missing_poi: Generic place enrichment can finish with categories missing on individual days. Accommodation search used only a 12 km radius and could therefore leave legitimate overnight days without a result.

changes.pending: Added a mobile-safe viewport contract: body-level overlay, 100dvh, safe-area padding, card max-height and scrolling, compact small-height layout.
changes.images: Removed opacity/scale switch animation and delayed 180 ms update. Exactly one image src change occurs every 1000 ms.
changes.routing: Both OSRM mirrors are raced for every leg; failed travel legs are explicitly retried with a longer window. Day 1 and final return are part of the same hard retry set.
changes.poi: Added a targeted per-day POI gap filler for restaurant, fuel and activity categories after generic place enrichment.
changes.accommodation: Accommodation lookup now expands from 12 km to 25 km when the first search is empty and accepts results within 28 km.
